nameForm.fullText: My Sister Lydia hereby Revoking and Disannulling all other wills hereuntofore made and Acknowledging this to be my Only Last will and testament

note.text: Evidence: Be it Remembered that I Charles Fransisco of Little Creek Neck, Kent County and State of Delaware being weak in Body But perfectly sound in mind and Memory do make and ordain this my Last Will and Tes
